## Findings ledger
- [D4.DOC1.F6] The text calls industry an “open book” and “text,” using writing metaphors to present production as a readable disclosure of human powers and the failed translation of desire — dim: metaphor — term: “open book” / “text” — mapping: industrial production makes human capacities and unrealised intentions legible — use: metaphorical — anchor: "Industry is... the open book of the essential powers of man." — doc: technique — confidence: high

sections_inspected: Entire supplied passage, including “The meaning of technique,” “Technique, creation and the constitution of the human world,” “The neutrality of technique,” and “Technique and politics”
scope_outcomes.criterion: Identify transferred relations and their limits, and distinguish metaphorical from literal or unresolved uses where the text marks the distinction
scope_outcomes.basis: The supplied passage contains multiple explicit metaphors and also explicitly labels, qualifies, or limits several of them.
limitations: The assessment is limited to the supplied extraction and does not establish claims about the full published work beyond that passage.
